gazetteer_names_needed.name: Alaşehir
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Philadelphia, town in Manisa Province, Turkey (about 28.5 E, 38.35 N); region of radius 25 km in the 1300 found event, the 1304 loss, the 1300-1304 keyframe and a war zone

gaps.what: No page on the Pervaneid line was opened; the 1322 end rests on one table row of the Anatolian beyliks page (Cliopatria says 1332; the Candar page annexes Sinop without a year); extent before 1305 unknown

Chobanid years at Kastamonu (1211-1309) rest on one table row; the date and manner of the Candar conquest of Kastamonu, the Ilkhanid vassalage years and the 1343-1344 hand-over to the Isfendiyar row are not on any page opened

Dates of the Hamid gains of 1333 and 1344 and of the Ankara reach (1363) are Cliopatria's only (confidence 1); the Catalan interlude at Simav and Kula, who held Kütahya in 1412-1413 and any Ilkhanid vassalage are undated or unstated; whose land the eastern lobe (38-48 E) of Cliopatria's 1344-1414 shapes is
Greatest extent of the beylik (the page lists Elmali, Finike and Kas among its centres, far beyond Cliopatria's 5,886 km2 Milas-Mugla shape) is undated; no area on the page
Territory before 1305 and after 1326 (who held Beysehir after Timurtash fled in 1327) and the shape's reach to Konya's plain are not on any page opened
Boundaries and wars (Aydin, Karasi, Germiyan, Genoa, Naxos), the 1402 restoration's author and the 1410 versus 1412 end are not settled by the pages opened

counterparts_needing_dossiers.name: Eastern-lobe states under Cliopatria's Germiyanids row, 1344-1414 (Jazira and Lake Van emirates; Artuqids of Mardin are a candidate)

problems: Cliopatria's Germiyanids shapes 1344-1414 carry an eastern lobe (Diyarbakir, Mardin, Sanliurfa, Van, Hasakah, Raqqa, Dihok; 38-48 E, up to 165 thousand km2) that no Germiyan page supports and that overlaps no other Cliopatria shape; cut away in the keyframes with a western polygon; whose land it is remains open. The 1431-1439 shape (Ankara) outlives the dynasty (January 1429) and is marked wrong.

beylik-of-sinop is the Pervaneid emirate of Sinop, a different state from the Candar dynasty (it shares Wikidata Q2096678 with beylik-of-isfendiyar only because Cliopatria attached the Candar dynasty article to both); it is not merged. kastamonu is the Chobanid then Candar principality that the Candar page treats as one realm with beylik-of-isfendiyar: the Isfendiyar author and the colour agent should reconcile (same family suggested).
beylik-of-saruhan shares Wikidata Q1968654 with `han` (the Warring States state of Han): different states, a Cliopatria id error; the id is kept as given.

Cliopatria omits the 1390 Ottoman takeover and 1402 restoration of Menteshe, Saruhan and Germiyan (and the 1381 Germiyan dowry); the dossiers code them. The Ottoman dossier (me-10) should mirror: gains 1381 (Germiyan), 1390 (all three), 1412 (Saruhan), 1426 (Menteshe), 1429 (Germiyan); losses in 1402 (all three); vassal_start 1414 / vassal_end 1426 for beylik-of-menteshe. The Timurid dossier should carry the 1402 restorations; the Karaman dossier the 1411 gain and 1414 loss of Kutahya; the Hamid dossier the 1333 and 1344 losses; the Ilkhanate dossier the Eshrefid conquest of 1326 and the Candar vassalage.

Two keyframe corrections are deliberately empty regions (beylik-of-sinop_1326, germiyanids_1431) and give 'region resolves to no cells' under --resolve. Existing-shape verdicts that only change years carry from/to; the validator accepts them.
The Anatolian beyliks table was read through WebFetch's own restatement (the tool said it restated the rows rather than copying them); dates taken from it are cited as table rows.
